extensionDescription.message: Download YouTube videos, audio and playlists plus public HLS/DASH streams with Segmenta.

videoCurrent.description: Option to download the current video.

playlistAll.description: Option to download the playlist; the placeholder is the item count.

toastSaved.description: Final notice with the file path.

streamDetected.description: Option for a detected HLS/DASH manifest URL.

errorGeneric.message: The operation could not be completed.

errorInvalidUrl.message: The URL is not valid or the site is not allowed.

errorInvalidMessage.message: The request is not valid for the extension.

errorTimeout.message: The native host did not answer in time.

errorHostUnavailable.message: The Segmenta native host was not found. Is segmenta-host installed?

errorDrmProtected.message: This content uses DRM protection and is not supported.

errorLiveNotSupported.message: Live streams are not supported yet.

errorManifestMalformed.message: The stream manifest is broken or empty.

errorStreamUnsupported.message: This stream uses out-of-scope features (encryption, subtitles or multiple tracks).

errorMediaBackend.message: yt-dlp or ffmpeg failed. Check that they are installed and up to date.

errorNotPublic.message: The content is not public or is unavailable.

popupSent.message: Task created. Follow the progress in the Segmenta window.

popupError.message: The task could not be created.

notAvailable.message: Segmenta is not available on this page.

taskAddedTitle.description: Notification title once the task is created.

taskAddedBody.description: Notification body with the destination folder.

taskAddedBodyGeneric.description: Notification body when the host reports no folder.

confirmTitle.description: Title of the capture confirmation window.

confirmIntro.message: The browser paused this download. Choose who finishes it.

confirmUnknownName.description: Shown when the download reports no file name.

confirmUnknownHost.description: Shown when the download reports no host.

confirmHostMagnet.description: Source shown for a magnet link, which has no http host.

confirmFolderPending.message: Pending: the daemon reports it when the task is created
confirmFolderPending.description: Folder shown when the daemon has not reported it yet.

confirmRejected.message: The download continues in the browser.
confirmRejected.description: Message shown after rejecting the capture.

confirmFailed.message: Could not add it to Segmenta. The download continues in the browser.
confirmFailed.description: Shown when the host rejects the task.

confirmInvalid.message: This confirmation is no longer valid. Close this window.
confirmInvalid.description: Shown when the window has no pending download.

captureKeptTitle.description: Shown when the task never received data in Segmenta.

captureKeptBody.message: Segmenta did not receive the data. The download continues in your browser.
captureKeptBody.description: Body of the notice when the browser copy is kept.

captureMissedTitle.description: Aviso de descarga que terminó antes de confirmarse.

captureMissedBody.message: The file $1 finished before it could be confirmed. It stayed in the browser; click this notification to add it to Segmenta.
captureMissedBody.description: Cuerpo con el nombre del archivo en $1 y la acción de añadirlo.
